evals.name: Clean Architecture Boundaries & Fail-Fast Configuration
evals.prompt: Evaluate a new backend service architecture to ensure strict Clean Architecture dependency boundaries and fail-fast configuration before any feature code is authored.
evals.expected_output: Verifies that domain entities and use cases have zero external dependencies and static configuration terminates immediately on invalid schemas.
assertions: Enforces strict 4-layer dependency inversion with outer-to-inner dependencies only
Validates fail-fast configuration schema during boot with non-zero exit on failure
Pre-warms database connection pool before opening network listener sockets
Includes Kubernetes preStop 5-second sleep hook to prevent in-flight connection drops

evals.name: Transactional Outbox & Dual-Write Elimination
evals.prompt: Review an order creation endpoint where an order record is inserted into the database and an event is emitted to a message broker.
evals.expected_output: Rejects direct dual-write to message queue and enforces the Transactional Outbox pattern where state and event are committed atomically in the same ACID transaction.
assertions: Identifies dual-write vulnerability between database transaction and message broker
Requires Transactional Outbox table insertion within the primary business transaction
Ensures outbox publisher operates asynchronously via CDC or background poller
Enforces idempotent message consumers with unique deduplication keys

evals.name: Database Pool Sizing & Zero-Downtime Safe DDL Migrations
evals.prompt: Design the database connection pool sizing and DDL migration strategy for a high-concurrency production service running across 10 Kubernetes pods.
evals.expected_output: Applies the pool sizing formula (cores * 2 + spindles), introduces a connection proxy (PgBouncer), and enforces Expand-and-Contract safe DDL with lock timeouts.
assertions: Calculates connection pool size using the (CPU_Cores * 2) + Spindles formula
Mandates connection proxy layer between multi-pod deployments and the database
Requires lock_timeout = '2s' on all DDL migration statements
Enforces 3-phase Expand-and-Contract pattern for non-breaking schema evolution
